hypothesis: BroadcomのQ1-Q3 FY2026におけるAI semiconductor revenue増加とGAAP gross profit増加を四半期差分で制約すると、AI semiconductor incremental gross marginの下限を前研究の60.68% break-evenより上に狭められる。
why_it_matters: 前研究の単一四半期segment-mix boundは56.16%-98.16%と広く、FY2027 purchase commitments 52.674B USDのgross-profit coverage判断を確定できなかった。複数四半期のrealized AI revenueとgross profitを使ってbreak-evenの上下をより強く制約できれば、Broadcomのcapital-at-risk評価を改善できる。

precommit_rule.use: Q1->Q2、Q2->Q3、Q1->Q3の全てでincremental AI gross-margin lower boundが60.68%以上。
precommit_rule.condition: 累積Q1->Q3 lower boundは60.68%以上だが、少なくとも1つの隣接四半期lower boundが60.68%未満、かつupper boundは60.68%超。
precommit_rule.unverified: AI semiconductor revenue、total revenue、GAAP gross profitの一次情報がいずれかの四半期で不足する。

broadcom_q1_fy2026_results.source: Broadcom Inc. Q1 FY2026 financial results published 2026-03-04

broadcom_q2_fy2026_results.source: Broadcom Inc. Q2 FY2026 financial results published 2026-06-03

broadcom_q3_fy2026_results.source: Broadcom Inc. Q3 FY2026 financial results published 2026-09-02

method.incremental_bridge: For each period pair, delta gross profit = m_AI * delta AI revenue + m_other * delta non-AI revenue, with m_other constrained to 0%-100%. This yields a transparent interval for the gross margin attributable to incremental AI revenue under a constant-base contribution bridge; no unreported segment margin is inserted.
method.formula: m_AI lower = (delta gross profit - delta non-AI revenue) / delta AI revenue; m_AI upper = delta gross profit / delta AI revenue, because all observed delta non-AI revenue is positive.
method.missing_data_policy: No segment margin, software margin or AI margin point estimate is imputed.

validation.look_ahead: Only realized Q1-Q3 FY2026 issuer-reported values available by 2026-09-11 are used; Q4 guidance is not used in the incremental-margin bridge.
validation.benchmark: Prior Q3 single-quarter algebraic margin bound 56.16%-98.16%.
validation.alternative: Adjacent-quarter and cumulative incremental contribution bounds using realized AI revenue, total revenue and GAAP gross profit.

result.finding: The cumulative Q1->Q3 incremental AI gross-margin lower bound is 64.08%, above the prior 60.68% purchase-commitment break-even, and Q1->Q2 is also fully above break-even at 74.25%-94.08%. However Q2->Q3 remains 59.95%-85.44%, crossing break-even by a narrow 0.74 percentage point at the lower edge. AI share of total revenue rose from 43.50% to 56.44% while consolidated GAAP gross margin stayed near 68.13%-69.48%, which is inconsistent with a large observed gross-margin collapse but does not identify structural AI segment margin. The evidence therefore materially narrows the prior uncertainty without proving every recent incremental AI dollar clears 60.68%.

risk_metrics.reason: This is fundamental incremental-margin research, not a realized trading strategy.

decision_rule: Keep Broadcom FY2027 purchase-commitment coverage at CONDITION rather than applying a standalone valuation penalty. The realized Q1-Q3 bridge makes a sub-60.68% AI incremental margin less plausible on a cumulative basis, but Q2->Q3 still crosses the threshold. Re-evaluate after Q4 FY2026 realized revenue and gross profit; if the Q3->Q4 and rolling Q2->Q4 lower bounds are both >=60.68%, promote the gross-profit coverage leg toward USE, subject to cash-conversion evidence remaining separate.
limitations: The incremental bridge assumes changes in gross profit can be decomposed between incremental AI revenue and incremental non-AI revenue with the latter's marginal gross margin constrained to 0%-100%; it does not identify gross-margin changes on the pre-existing revenue base.
AI revenue is issuer-reported but AI-specific gross profit is not disclosed.
The Q2->Q3 lower bound is only 0.74 percentage point below break-even, so modest base-margin shifts could change that edge result.
This study addresses gross-profit capacity only; FCF/cash coverage remains a separate unresolved leg from the prior research.
next_hypothesis: Broadcom Q4 FY2026 realized AI revenue, total revenue, GAAP gross profit and FCFを追加したQ3->Q4 / rolling Q2->Q4 bridgeで、60.68% gross-profit break-evenと1.0x cash coverageの両方を同時に満たせるか。
